what:
More Plan 1b decisions, agreed 2026-10-20:
- PlanarMap is @opaque, and "no crossing edges" stays a documented precondition, with a fast unchecked insert plus one checked variant.
- weld/2 (was mergeMap) returns an explicit old-to-new handle map in place of Taprats' scratch `copy` pointers.
- Renderer per-node data lives in a side table keyed by handle, not in the graph.
- The sorted vertex/edge lists keep Taprats' 1e-7 comparators and early-exit scans.
- The renames are replicate/2 (was mergeSimpleMany) and weld/2 (was mergeMap).
- Faces' colour-consistency failure returns an error tuple instead of raising.
